SIG127 American Mortise Kit with 203 Square Rose

AHI-SIG127 Mortise lock with Sarin lever and 203 2" square rosette is ideal for residential and light commercial applications. Mortise locks are UL 10C listed and combine precision engineering for security and durability with attractive designs.

Each set contains door levers, 203 square rosette, mortise latchset, spindle, and all necessary screws and templates. Key functions are supplied with lock cylinder/s and turnpiece as applicable.

Specifications for AHI-SIG127AM Mortise Set

  • 203 Rose: 2" Square
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" - 2-1/4", Optional to 2-1/4" and up
  • Backset: 2-1/2"or 2-3/4"
  • Lever Hub: 8mm square
  • Solid Stainless Door Lever and Rosette
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy galvanized steel and brass
  • Front: Adjustable stainless steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid stainless steel faceplate for all lock bodies, finished to match trim.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • Lock Cylinder: Standard 5 pin "C" keyway supplied with two nickel silver keys.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Passage (Hall / Closet): Latchbolt operates by lever from either side.
  • Privacy (Bathroom / Bedroom): Latchbolt operates by lever from either side. Deadbolt by turnpiece inside and emergency key outside. Turning inside knob will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.
  • Classroom Entry: Latchbolt operates by key outside and lever either side unless outside lever is locked by key outside. Auxillary latch deadlocks latch bolt.
  • Panic Proof Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button; then opens by key outside, by lever inside. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside. Turning inside lever retracts latch and deadbolt simultaneously while outside lever remains locked.
  • Office Entry: Latchbolt operates by key outside and lever from either side unless outside lever is locked by toggle stop button. Auxiliary latch deadlocks latchbolt.
  • Storeroom: Latchbolt operates by lever inside and key outside. Outside lever is always rigid. Auxillary latch deadlocks latchbolt.
